name: Sesame-Masala Tuna Fritters with Coriander Aioli & Roasted Veggies

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 crowns broccoli
6 medium carrots
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; divide between two baking sheet pans.
Peel, trim, and thinly slice carrots; add to the baking sheets with the broccoli. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain tuna, place in a large bowl, and flake with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (170 g) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into the bowl with the tuna. Add eggs, almond flour, sesame seeds, mayo, and spices; stir well to combine. (Reserve lemons for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggs
⅓ cup almond meal/flour
¼ cup sesame seeds
3 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp garam masala
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a ¼-cup measure, form the tuna mixture into ½-inch thick fritters and place on a large plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add fritters and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, juice the reserved lemons into a small bowl; add mayo and spices. Stir to combine the aioli.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide veggies, tuna fritters, and aioli between plates. Enjoy!
